ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; the visible ventral surface is dominated by low-intensity (near-black) pixels (>98%), with high-intensity (white/tan) pixels restricted to water highlights and tip anomalies.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid dark pigmentation across the entire visible fluke; a single high-contrast cluster of tan and white pixels is localized at the distal tip of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression at the central axis, with an approximate angle of 125 degrees and a depth roughly 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the full extent of the trailing edge; individual peaks and valleys show varying amplitudes of 3-10 pixels against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the proximal edge leading to convex curves on the distal trailing edges; lobes taper to sharp points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of circular/ovoid high-contrast pixels (tan/white) concentrated at the apex of the right lobe tip, typical of barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertically-oriented linear disruptions of low-intensity contrast visible in the central-left fluke region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent biological encrustation cluster on the distal right tip; the trailing edge exhibits numerous irregular nicks and jagged points suggestive of historical mechanical wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Dynamic water spray and splash patterns occluding the distal end of the left lobe and the base of the peduncle.
